title: Digital Media Technician
jobDescription:
Required Travel :Minimal

Location: :[[req Location]]

Who are we?

Amdocs helps the world’s leading communications and media companies deliver exceptional customer experiences through reliable, efficient, and secure operations at scale. We provide software products and services that embed intelligence into how work runs across business, IT, and network domains –delivering measurable outcomes in customer experience, network performance, cloud modernization, and revenue growth. With our talented people, and more than forty years of experience running mission-critical systems around the globe, Amdocs runs billions of transactions daily. Our technology is relied on every day, connecting people worldwide and advancing a more inclusive, connected world. Together, we help those who shape the future to make it amazing. Amdocs is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NASDAQ: DOX) and reported revenue of $4.53 billion in fiscal 2025. For more information, visit www.amdocs.com

At Amdocs, our mission is to empower our employees to 'Live Amazing, Do Amazing' every day. We believe in creating a workplace where you not only excel professionally but also thrive personally. Through our culture of making a real impact, fostering growth, embracing flexibility, and building connections, we enable them to live meaningful lives while making a difference in the world.

In one sentence

Your main responsibility is to manage and scheduling the processing of film, TV video assets through the digital workflow from ingest to delivery

What will your job look like?

  • Creating deliverable files that adhere to client specifications
  • Conforming/syncing/editing audio/video assets
  • Evaluating the quality of and checking for errors in digital video/audio assets
  • Describing and identifying the severity of issues in content
  • Confirming basic technical requirements and client specifications
  • Ensuring overall integrity and quality of content (video, audio, captions, etc.) adhere to standards as well as any additional client specific requirements
  • Work with engineering to address hardware/software concerns /upgrades as needed
  • Confirming basic technical requirements and client specifications
  • Ensure overall integrity and quality of content (video, audio, captions, etc.) adhere to standards as well as any additional client specific requirements
  • Identify and document any encoding related issues

All you need is...

  • Experience : 2 to 7 year
  • Excellent written and spoken language skills in English
  • Experience with common office applications
  • Basic understanding of digital media technologies including encoding and quality control standards
  • Experience in post-production services will be considered a PLUS
  • Prior Audio/Video Editing experience or education is required
  • Familiarity with various file formats (IMF, Pro Res, scc, dxfp, pac, itt), standards, resolutions, frame rates, etc. will be considered a plus
  • Experience with Final Cut, Premiere and/or other editing software is a plus
  • Experience with digital video/audio encoding systems is a plus
  • Experience with Pro Tools preferred is a plus
  • Resolve and Colorfront experience preferred
  • Familiarity with video mastering and localization processes is a plus

Why you will love this job:

We are a company built on positive relationships and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to build strong business relationships.

You will manage multiple business relationships and collaborate with people from both corporate and field.

This is an opportunity to work independently, in a fast-paced environment, and lead projects.

Amdocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce
